children: Intel (INTC) guides Q4 revenue $15–$16B, below the roughly $17.1B estimate, and says no positive cash flow for the year, signaling shortfalls versus consensus on revenue and annual cash flow.
U.S. government bought 433.3M INTC shares (~9.9%) in Aug 2025 at $20.47. After a sharp intraday drop, the stake’s value fell from ~$39.9B to ~$27.7B, a ~$12.2B one-day loss.
Five-year CDS spreads for Intel Corporation (INTC) widened up to 22.4 basis points to 127.9 bps, raising the market cost to insure Intel’s five-year debt.
Intel (INTC) reported a multi-week shutdown at Fab 28 in Israel, cutting Q4 revenue by about $300 million and trimming gross margin roughly 200 basis points from damaged 10nm server wafers.
Intel (INTC) forecasted client computing sales to fall over 20% year‑over‑year and quarter‑over‑quarter, citing weak PC demand and detailing the decline for its client computing segment in guidance.
Intel (INTC) warned of higher cash spending. The alert sparked a tech selloff, drove the Nasdaq to a two-month low and pushed investors toward safer assets amid falling U.S. Treasury yields.
Intel plans to scale its foundry business: high-volume 18A production at a new Arizona plant, a second Arizona plant by end-2028, customer wins due in two quarters, and progress on 14A chips.
Intel (INTC) says 18A wafer costs fell ~40% from Q1 to Q3, yields rose double digits, Clearwater Forest 18A server chips began shipping, and Wildcat Lake client CPU units rose ~70% sequentially.
Intel says PC market slump will persist into mid‑2027. CEO Lip‑Bu Tan gave the timeline; CFO David Zinsner cites high memory prices and tight IT budgets as causes.
Intel (INTC) says supply constraints—raw material shortages and a temporary Israel plant closure—limited its ability to meet rising data-center demand amid favorable AI-driven demand trends.
